page: Amazon Web Services c6id.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 128 vCPUs and 64 physical cores from an Intel Xeon 8375C processor operating at 3.5 GHz. The system includes 256.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, translating to 2.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance is equipped with 7600 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and specialized execution capabilities. The processor achieved a Passmark CPU score of 86804.16 and a multi-core stress-ng score of 123836.17, both placing in the top tiers. Extended instruction sets, including AVX-512 and cryptography acceleration (AES, VAES, SHA_NI), contribute to high performance in encryption and vector math, with the Passmark encryption test reaching 110784.01. Memory bandwidth is also highly rated, with uncached large-block reads measuring 332.31 GB/sec.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high-capacity local NVMe storage, this instance is optimized for compute-heavy workloads that require fast local scratch space. It is highly suitable for database operations, high-throughput web serving, and software compilation, as evidenced by its strong Passmark database score and 68.84 GB/sec static web serving throughput. However, with 2.0 GB of memory per core, it may not be suitable for memory-bound applications requiring massive in-memory datasets.
